prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Survival Arena field-selection thumbnail. Primary request: the lower streets and plazas of a medieval royal capital hastily converted into a goblin manhunt zone. Scene/backdrop: stone townhouses, gatehouse, market square, walls and hurried wooden barricades. Subject: several readable street corridors feeding into open plazas, with narrow chokepoints but no dead ends; a grand fortified city gate as landmark. Style/medium: polished hand-drawn stylized storybook cutout environment illustration; flat 2D shapes, thick slightly irregular ink outlines, matte colors, simple cel shading, subtle paper texture; warm ironic fairy-tale danger; not pixel art, not photorealistic, not 3D. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, readable 3/4 top-down overview, clear traversable routes and obstacle rhythm, one strong environmental focal landmark, foreground framing kept subtle, works when center-cropped and downscaled to a 170-pixel-high UI card. Lighting/mood: clear readable daylight, controlled contrast. Color palette: warm limestone, slate roofs, muted burgundy and royal blue accents. Constraints: environment only; no characters, enemies, creatures, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark; no close-up object; no map labels; preserve broad open gameplay space. Avoid: modern city elements, fully enclosed alleys, active crowds, extreme darkness.
